name: Neptune
defines: Where the boundaries blur — what you idealise, imagine and can deceive yourself about. Neptune spends about fourteen years in a sign, so this is a description of your generation's dream; the house it falls in shows where it touches your own life.

aries.definition: A generation that idealised the pioneer and the fresh start. The dream was of the individual who simply begins again.
aries.showsUp: You are inspired by courage and self-invention, and you can romanticise action for its own sake.

taurus.definition: A generation that idealised abundance and the land. The dream was of a settled, plentiful, physically beautiful life.
taurus.showsUp: You are moved by beauty in tangible things, and you can be sentimental about money, property or a simpler past.

gemini.definition: A generation that idealised communication and cleverness. The dream was that if we could all just talk to each other, it would be solved.
gemini.showsUp: You are enchanted by words and ideas, and you can mistake a well-put argument for a true one.

cancer.definition: A generation that idealised home and belonging. The dream was of the family that keeps you safe.
cancer.showsUp: You are deeply moved by anything to do with roots and childhood, and you can be nostalgic for a past that was never quite like that.

leo.definition: A generation that idealised glamour and the performing self. The dream was of the transcendent star.
leo.showsUp: You are drawn to romance and spectacle, and you can lose yourself in an image of who you would like to be.

virgo.definition: A generation that idealised purity, health and being of service. The dream was that things could be made properly clean.
virgo.showsUp: You are inspired by craft and by care, and you can be undone by a standard of purity that nothing real ever meets.

libra.definition: A generation that idealised the perfect partnership. The dream was of relationships as harmony without cost.
libra.showsUp: You are moved by art and by fairness, and you can idealise a person past the point where you can see them.

scorpio.definition: A generation that idealised intensity and transformation. The dream was that going all the way down would purify something.
scorpio.showsUp: You are drawn to what is taboo or hidden, and you can mistake intensity for meaning.

sagittarius.definition: A generation that idealised faith and the far horizon. The dream was that the answer was somewhere else.
sagittarius.showsUp: You are inspired by philosophy and by travel, and you can chase a belief further than the evidence goes.

capricorn.definition: A generation that idealised achievement and institutions — and then watched the idealisation dissolve.
capricorn.showsUp: You are moved by mastery and legacy, and you can be disillusioned when the structures you trusted turn out to be ordinary.

aquarius.definition: A generation that idealised the collective and the technological future. The dream was of a networked humanity.
aquarius.showsUp: You are inspired by shared causes and by what technology might make possible, and you can be utopian about how people actually behave.

pisces.definition: A generation that idealised compassion and dissolution itself. Neptune rules this sign, so the dream was the medium rather than the message.
pisces.showsUp: You are unusually porous to atmosphere, art and suffering, and you need deliberate structure to keep from drifting.
